name: Kisaragi Ren
source: A college student attending dental school. Ren has boyfriend problems, and so, seeks advice from the protagonist, to which he suggests getting pregnant. She asks the protagonist for some pocket money when they have sex. She calls the protagonist 'Onii-san'.
